rules.sentence: NA can be presented in multiple ways, but classically sudden pain at the top of the shoulder blade develops, lasting for a few days or weeks, eventually leading to paralysis of the shoulder girdle.
Cervical radiculopathy usually causes more severe pain than PMNC and the pain radiates from the neck to the distal hand.
TOS is a condition in which symptoms can consist of nerve, artery or vein compressions.
Differential diagnosis for PMNC should include CTS but also nerve root compression at the cervical spine and compression at the brachial plexus such as TOS.
